Mulching & Weeding in the Blue Mountains

Fresh mulch, weed removal and weed control that keeps your garden beds healthy, tidy and low-maintenance.

Mulch is the cheapest, best thing you can do for a garden — it locks in moisture, keeps roots cool and suppresses weeds. We clear the weeds first, then top up with quality mulch.

Regular weeding and mulching keeps beds looking sharp and cuts down the work over summer.

What’s included

  • Weed removal and clearing
  • Ongoing weed control
  • Supply and spread quality mulch
  • Bark, woodchip and decorative mulch
  • Healthier, lower-maintenance beds
  • One-off or seasonal
